name: WhatsApp
summary: Preview: receive WhatsApp messages through Twilio and keep a log.
description: A first step for WhatsApp in Girru, through a Twilio WhatsApp number. It receives the messages Twilio sends to Girru's address, only when Twilio signed them with your auth token, and keeps them in a log you can read; you can limit it to the numbers you list. Your agents can log a message for a number, but sending through Twilio is not built yet: nothing leaves Girru. It does not answer messages by itself.
permissions: Opens one public address (/api/ext/whatsapp/webhook) that accepts only requests Twilio signed with your auth token
Keeps the Twilio settings you save; the auth token is never sent back to the page
Keeps the messages it receives and logs in its own tables, with the sender's phone number
Sends nothing to Twilio or anywhere else yet
Adds a whatsapp_send tool (it logs only) that agents can use once you allow them
